lines.trans: Senya, look how the caviar shines!
I told you, the dye is great.
It looks like genuine black caviar.
This dish is called pike easter.
Why specifically pike easter?
Because it is a real culinary miracle!
Give me a spoon, I want to taste.
Taste a tiny bit, just do not eat it all.
Listen, the taste is simply magnificent.
Our guests will be in total delight.
The main thing is that Chef suspects nothing.
Chef will not find out anything, hide the jar!
